description:
Cast Aether Adept by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus artifact token.
Resolve Aether Adept. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Aether Adept trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat
